verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts that give non-human systems programmatic API access without tying credentials to a user. It also documents a role-based access model in which custom roles group fine-grained transactions and are assigned to principals, which together support least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that service-account keys can be bound to custom scoped roles, any agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
